# @addozhang/dsh-turn-toc
English | 简体中文
Turn section outline (TOC) plugin for the **DeepSeek Harness** Web & Desktop GUI.
It sits in the right gutter just outside the centered message column—sharing the frameless tick-mark
aesthetic of DSH's built-in `TurnNavigator`—and expands on hover into an interactive multi-level he
ading outline for the turn you are currently reading.
## Features
- **Frameless Tick Marks at Rest**: Renders subtle horizontal tick bars graded by heading level (`H1
`–`H6`) right beside the message column, keeping your visual focus on the right without covering any

text or colliding with the outer `TurnNavigator`.
- **Dual Scroll Spy (Turn + Heading)**: Automatic
ally tracks which Turn is at the viewport reading line and highlights the active section (`H1`–`H6`)

as you scroll.
- **Hover to Expand & Pin**: Smoothly expands into a translucent `MenuSurface` outli

ne card on pointer hover, with a pin toggle to keep the outline open when desired.
- **1-Click Secti
on Jump**: Click any heading row (or click a tick mark directly without expanding) to smoothly scrol

l to that section with a brief highlight flash.
- **Quick Turn Flipping**: Header buttons let you ju
mp to the top of the current Turn (`Turn N`) or step directly to the previous (`↑`) / next (`↓`) Tur

n.
- **Responsive Auto-Hide**: Appears only when the conversation container (`>= 1280px`) and right
gutter (`>= 176px`) have enough room to expand strictly to the right without overlapping the message
column or the outer `TurnNavigator`.
